candidate_metadata.asset_handoff: The exact chosen draft, original redacted correspondence/fact notes labelled S1/S2, audience/purpose and stated missing facts. Do not use the primary model-generated Facts I supplied section as independent evidence. Primary drafts; complementary prompt audits original sources; human corrects and decides whether to send.
duplicate_decision: Cover letter: new application letter mapping qualifications to posting. Follow-up: existing contact and unanswered request become a short request for an update.
Weekly project status: recurring multi-source report of execution. Follow-up: one recipient/action from prior correspondence; no project-report page or dashboard.
Meeting minutes: records a meeting and actions. Follow-up: message to seek a reply; no new meeting transcript or minutes.
Proposal and presentation: approval document or slide deck; follow-up does not create either.
Audio transcription, PDF tables, CSV dedupe, flashcards, resume bullets and study scheduling have different inputs/outputs.
Six legacy routes also checked: PDF merge/extract, image compress/resize, duplicate CSV removal and CSV-to-JSON do not own this intent.
